subject: Intro: OpenShop (via EdgeScale) - Request to schedule demo

Hi Marissa / Rachel,

Hope you’re both well — quick intro. I’m Tom Hargrove at EdgeScale, and we recently finished a discovery session with OpenShop (cc’d: Claire). They’re evaluating LLM-enabled search and recommendation features and asked for an intro/demo with Redwood to understand inference options and deployment models.

Claire, Redwood is the inference platform I mentioned — great latency/cost levers for production, plus options for private deployments. I’m copying Rachel (our Redwood partner lead) and Marissa (SDR) to get a demo on the calendar and loop in a solutions engineer.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Feb 16, 1:00–1:30pm
- Wed Feb 17, 10:00–10:30am

Claire, which of those works for you? Happy to be on the call to help with context. I’ve attached a short partner intro.

Thanks,
Tom Hargrove
Partnerships, EdgeScale

Hi Tom / Claire — thanks for the intro!

Claire — great to meet you. I’m Marissa on the Redwood SDR team. We’d love to get a 30-minute demo scheduled to cover the platform, common deployment patterns, and a quick technical Q&A.

Quick agenda (attached):
- 5m intros and goals
- 15m demo (hosted + dedicated + private options)
- 10m technical Q&A / next steps (MAP and PoC ask)

Available slots (PST):
- Tue Feb 16, 1:00–1:30pm
- Wed Feb 17, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu Feb 18, 10:00–10:30am

If one of those works I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in our SE. Also copying Rachel to coordinate partner context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up and the agenda.

We’d like to aim for Thu Feb 18 but need it to be 45 minutes (we have a few stakeholders who will join). Top goals: validate latency for 200–300ms p99 for customer-facing search, and understand options for private (VPC/on-prem) deployments + SOC2 evidence.

Can you please include an SE and the partner manager on the call?

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
